programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan follows Ross Poldark's trail in Cornwall: dancing in Helston, scything near Liskeard, sailing in Falmouth, exploring tin mining and the county's wartime history - plus bagpipes.

programs.title: Motorway Cops: Catching Britain's Speeders
programs.desc: PCs Jan and Jamie are gobsmacked by a driver who doesn't seem to have a problem with drink driving. Later the duo pursues a car hitting a speed of 150mph.

programs.title: Police Interceptors
programs.desc: There's a blistering pursuit on the M1 as Interceptors chase a vehicle veering across lanes, pushing the speed to 115mph. And we follow the dog unit as three canine cops are trained.

programs.title: Major Crimes Unit
programs.desc: In Dudley, after gunfire rips through a young mother's front door and a shot strikes her in the hip, the team are tasked with identifying the perpetrators, leaving no stone unturned.

programs.title: Traffic Cops: Pursuit Squad One
programs.desc: This series from the makers of Traffic Cops follows the country's highly trained police bikers: the UK's fastest responders, racing to save lives and catch suspects.

programs.title: Police: Night Shift 999
programs.desc: Return of the series following the work of the Gloucestershire Police officers. Reports come in about a man in a residential street armed with a hammer and a knife.
